main_text.p: ipso colligere possum, me miserrimum hominem fateor. Ideoque fas mihi sit, ut missis caeteris, in hoc, pro virili mea, totus nunc sim, ut, ad fidem meam tuendam & confirmandam, adversus varias tentationes MERITUM, SATISFACTIONEM & JUSTITIAM Sponsoris mei JESU CHRISTI contra acerbos ejus hostes, asseram, adeoque hac me consolatione destitui non permittam.

Interim velim Lectorem observare, me in illorum librorum lectione observasse, istorum hominum, de quibus mihi sermo est, dogmata, in omnibus fere Christianae fidei articulis, ab orthodoxa nostra Ecclesia recedere, & multiformia haereticorum olim ab Ecclesia damnatorum commeta revocare magno conatu, & in unum quoddam, quasi novae Theologiae monstrum formandum, comportare.
main_text.head: I. In Doctrina de Deo impugnant
main_text.p: Personarum Divinarum Trinitatem: Filii Dei aeternam divinitatem, Spiritus Sancti hypostasin, & divinam essentiam pernegant. Christi Officium & virtutem lacerant & labefactant.

page.notes: Left margin notes, both in small italic: "Multiplex dissensio Neoterorum a doctrina nostra" (beside the first paragraph) and "Dissensus in doctrina de Deo" (beside the heading I.). The first note's wording is partly rubbed, so I have read it as printed but the second word of the first note is uncertain. The first paragraph's opening "ipso" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The line "me in illorum librorum lectione observasse" is my reading of a line I could not read letter by letter: please check it. The text of the second paragraph's middle portion ("observasse, istorum hominum") is uncertain, and the tail of the page, from "Interim", should be checked against the scan. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
